description: Official LaTeX template for the LaTeLL 2026 conference proceedings. Provides a two-column A4 layout with review-mode line numbers and confidentiality banner, blind-review-compatible title/author blocks, an abstract environment, resized figure/table captions, and natbib-based author-year citations with backward-compatible cite/newcite/shortcite aliases, based on a custom latell style package (derived from ACL-IJCNLP 2021) built on the article class.
